Hi, 

I have a model where I have observations with varying levels of confidence. My idea is to model this with different likelihoods for the two data sources and define the precission for each in control.family. 

Perhaps I have missed something, but it is not clear how I can specify different hyperparameters for the different likelihoods. Both observation models are Gaussian in this case. 

Best, 
Michael

messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] differing measurement uncertainty
parts:
Hi,

I had not found that resource. It was very clear.
In the inla call  we then have 
inla(..., 
    family = list(likelihood1, likelihood2), 
    control.family = list(
        list(settings for likelihood 1),
        list(settings for likelihood2)
        ),
    )


Thank you, 
Michael
